title: Core Cloud
description: Oculos that store items you can use.
body:
Ever thought about having virtual reality oculos to store your items? Well, that's what this mod brings to Minecraft. The hotkey is "V" and the oculos can be crafted with a glass pane next to an iron ingot.



Shortcuts for the oculos interface:

Without focus on the search box:

Q = previous page
E = next page
V = focus on the search box
ESC = close the oculos interface

With focus on the search box:

ESC = exit focus on the search box
